ask: can u figure out who pays who so its the fewest venmos
sentence: Splits shared expenses evenly among everyone in the chat and shows the fewest payments needed to settle up, with a way for each person to mark their payment as sent.
use_when: A group shared costs on a trip or weekend and needs to know who pays whom
Several people each paid for different things and want an even split
Someone wants the fewest Venmo or cash transfers to settle a group bill
People want to add or remove expenses and track which payments are done
dont_use_when: The split should be uneven, by percentage, or by item per person
A single shared bill at a restaurant needs to be divided by what each person ordered
The group wants a running tally of money over months or recurring bills
